author: Thoughty2
description:
We've all tried to get ourselves out of trouble, but for most of us that doesn't involve selling our soul to the Devil. 

According to legend, the Codex Gigas (meaning ‘giant book’) was created by a monk who made a deal with Satan to finish the world's largest medieval manuscript in a single night. That’s a pretty bold solution to a tight deadline.

The book is a mystery - because a manuscript this enormous should have required several monks working some serious overtime. And by overtime, I mean decades. Yet somehow, the handwriting remains remarkably consistent from the very first page to the very last.
title: Did Satan Help Write This Book?
